_comment: Akron — generation-A workbook. NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Akron, OH MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 2 MSA counties (Summit, Portage), Portage (Ohio)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 23 geocoded venue(s) of 25 in this batch (observed lat 40.9156..41.3028, lng -81.6320..-81.2569).
